android.desc:
Build lasting habits with streaks that motivate you every day. Focus Streak is the habit tracker that lets you complete habits in one tap, see progress on your home screen with widgets, and keep your data private – no account needed.

Whether you want to exercise daily, read more, meditate, drink more water, or stay consistent with any routine, Focus Streak helps you track habits, build streaks, and stay motivated. Join thousands of people building better habits with an app that focuses on what matters: consistency.

🔥 WHY CHOOSE FOCUS STREAK?

Unlike complicated habit tracker apps, Focus Streak keeps things simple. The streak-based approach provides natural motivation, while clear visualisations make it easy to see your progress at a glance.

🎯 KEY FEATURES

Quick & Intuitive
• Swipe right to complete habits, left to undo – no fumbling for buttons
• Tap "Done" in notifications to see your progress instantly
• Overall scores and better habit tracking so you know how you're doing
• View archived habits anytime – nothing is lost, just tucked away

Streak-Based Motivation
• Track your current streak for each habit
• Never lose progress – use streak freeze or mark past days complete from the calendar
• Celebrate your longest streak achievements
• Stay motivated with daily momentum reminders and visual progress indicators

Smart Habit Management
• Make it yours – personalise each habit with any emoji you choose
• Drag & search – reorder habits your way, find them instantly with search
• Time-bound habits – set start and end dates for challenges and short sprints
• Completion notes – record thoughts and reflections when you finish a habit
• Flexible schedules: daily, weekly, or custom patterns; unlimited reminders
• One-tap completion with satisfying feedback

Beautiful Visual Tracking & Analytics
• Clean, minimal design with colourful habit cards and dark mode (automatic system detection)
• See streaks at a glance – home screen widgets so you don't have to open the app
• Calendar view for your full habit history; today screen with all habits in one place
• Weekly and monthly completion rates, progress charts, and detailed habit insights

Milestones & Social Sharing
• Celebrate streaks with beautiful, shareable milestone cards
• Share your habit wins with friends and family
• Customise cards with your progress and style

Personal Profile
• Add your name and photo, timezone, and time format for a personalised experience

show_hn.title: Show HN: Focus Streak – simple, privacy-first streak habit tracker (Android)

quotes.text:
Hi HN — I built Focus Streak, a lightweight habit tracker for Android focused on streak-based motivation and privacy-first design.

Key points:
- Streak-based motivation + calendar view and stats
- Custom habits, multiple reminders, and offline-first (no account required)
- Minimal UI designed to reduce friction and help users actually keep daily routines
- Built with React Native + Expo; recently published to Google Play

I’d love feedback on:
- UX: what frustrates you on habit apps today?
- Growth/ASO: best tactics we should try next?
- Any crash/bug reports (device model + android version helps)

Play Store: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.focusstreak.app&utm_source=hackernews&utm_medium=showhn&utm_campaign=launch

Thanks — I’ll be around to reply to comments and answer technical questions.
